newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - India's Bajaj starts.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - India's Bajaj starts.

text.p: -- Caspian Securities said on Thursday it had started coverage of Bajaj Auto Ltd with a rating of market performer.
-- Analyst Rakesh Parekh wrote in a report that he started the coverage of Bajaj at a price of 976.75 rupees, or $27.28, a share.
-- "We believe BAL's global-scale efficiencies, industry-leading margins, high level of cash reserves and dominance in the two- and three-wheeler industry are reflected in the share price," he said.
-- "... Our 12-month price target is 1125 rupees, representing a total return of 16.4 percent including a dividend yield of 1.23 percent."
